info.title: BAX Print Suite media library and profiling API
info.description: Every route except `GET /openapi.json` needs a permission of the caller's role and answers 403 `forbidden` without it; `details.permission` names the missing permission. An actor resolver configured to deny anonymous callers answers 401 `unauthenticated` when no credential verifier recognizes the caller. Spec 029c: when API tokens are enabled, `Authorization: Bearer bps_...` authenticates as the token, whose permissions are exactly its scopes; an unknown, revoked, expired or malformed token answers 401 `unauthenticated` and never falls back. Other credentials are ignored. Managing tokens needs the admin-only `webhooks:*` permissions, and a caller may only issue scopes it holds. Spec 030c: when site scoping is enabled (`BPS_SITE_SCOPE=1`), every `/jobs/{id}` route answers 404 `not_found` for a job of a site the caller's membership does not grant, and `GET /archive` and `GET /trash` list only the jobs of granted sites; a job without a `siteId` belongs to the `default` site, and a caller without a membership sees no jobs. The site is read from the stored job, never from the request. Without a configured actor resolver every caller is treated as the local admin, which holds every permission. The server binds 127.0.0.1 by default; do not expose it beyond loopback without a resolver. With login on (`BPS_LOGIN=1`), `POST /login` starts a session and every guarded route needs its token, as the `bps_session` cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer` header; a caller without one gets 401 and there is no local admin. Spec 031c: a job records `sourceFormat` (`pdf`, `png`, `jpeg` or `tiff`), detected from the magic bytes of its first source file, and omits it when the bytes match none of them. Job creation takes any bytes; a hot folder takes in TIFF, JPEG and PNG files only when its settings have `acceptRaster: true`, and otherwise matches its `filePatterns` alone. Spec 035b: `sourceFormat` may also be `svg` or `dxf`, read from the SVG root element or the ASCII DXF section header, never from the file name; a hot folder takes in SVG and DXF files only when its settings have `acceptVector: true`. Preflight of such a job runs the vector checks (`vector-size`, `vector-markup`) on the header alone; nothing an SVG declares or references is fetched. Spec 034a: the `/jobs/{id}/print` routes exist only with `BPS_PRINT_OUTPUT=1` and a printer plugin (`BPS_PRINTER_PLUGIN`); they send the job's PDF source to it through `printer/submitDocument`. A device that takes no finished documents or not this format answers 409 `document_input_unsupported`, a document above its limit 413 `document_too_large`, and any other plugin failure 502 `printer_error`; each carries the plugin's uppercase code in `details.code`. Spec 038c: a job may carry an optional `whiteInk` setting (`WhiteInkSetting`); absent means white ink is off, and a stored value that is not a valid setting reads back absent. `PUT` and `DELETE /jobs/{id}/white-ink` set and clear it, and exist only with `BPS_WHITE_INK=1`. Spec 039c: a job may carry an optional `screening` setting (`ScreeningSetting`); absent means no screening is requested, and a stored value that is not a valid setting reads back absent. `PUT` and `DELETE /jobs/{id}/screening` set and clear it, and exist only with `BPS_SCREENING=1`. Spec 040c: a job may carry an optional `inkLimit` setting (`InkLimitSetting`); absent means no ink limit is requested, and a stored value that is not a valid setting reads back absent. `PUT` and `DELETE /jobs/{id}/ink-limit` set and clear it, and exist only with `BPS_INK_LIMIT=1`. Spec 043a: `POST /jobs/{id}/screen-preview` screens CMYK planes with the job's `screening` and `inkLimit` settings and answers them packed 1 bit per pixel; nothing is stored. A job without `screening` answers 409 `screening_not_set`. It exists only with `BPS_SCREEN_PREVIEW=1`. Spec 043b: with `format: "pbm"` in the body, each plane is answered as a raw PBM (`P4`) file instead, and the answer names its `format`. Spec 044d: a job may carry an optional `planeCurves` setting (`PlaneCurvesSetting`); absent means no curves are requested, and a stored value that is not a valid setting reads back absent. `PUT` and `DELETE /jobs/{id}/plane-curves` set and clear it, and exist only with `BPS_PLANE_CURVES=1`. Spec 044e: `POST /jobs/{id}/screen-preview` applies stored `planeCurves` after the ink limit and before screening; a job without them is screened as before, and a job with curves but no `screening` still answers 409 `screening_not_set`. Spec 050a: a job may carry an optional `tiling` setting (`TilingSetting`); absent means the job is not tiled, and a stored value that is not a valid setting reads back absent. `PUT` and `DELETE /jobs/{id}/tiling` set and clear it, and exist only with `BPS_TILING=1`. Spec 052a: `POST /jobs`, `GET /jobs` and `GET /jobs/{id}` exist only with `BPS_JOB_INTAKE=1`. An upload is a raw `application/pdf` body of at most 256 MiB (lower with `BPS_JOB_INTAKE_MAX_BYTES`) that starts with `%PDF-`; it is stored under a server-generated name, never the client's. `GET /health` is public and always mounted.

get.summary: List the active jobs, newest first, one page at a time

schema.description: Page size; a value above 200 is capped at 200
Opaque cursor from a previous page's `nextCursor`

200.description: `{ items, nextCursor }`: with site scoping only the jobs of the caller's sites; `nextCursor` is null on the last page

400.description: `limit` is not a positive integer (`invalid_request`) or `cursor` is not one this route issued

post.summary: Upload a PDF as a new job. The optional `x-bps-job-name` header is kept, sanitized, as the display name only

schema.description: Site of the new job (Spec 030a); without it the job has no `siteId` and belongs to `default`

201.description: `{ job }`: the new job, `received`, with the upload as its only source file

400.description: The body does not start with `%PDF-` (`upload_not_pdf`), or `siteId` is not a valid site id (`invalid_argument`); nothing is written

413.description: The upload is larger than the cap, 64 bytes: by content-length (`upload_too_large`) or, for a body without one, while it is read (`invalid_request`); nothing is written

404.description: No job has this id (`not_found`). With site scoping enabled, a job of a site the caller's membership does not grant answers like a missing job (`not_found`)

post.summary: Plans the cut job of a job's page from its cutContour edit or the configured cut settings

200.description: The cut job, or `{ kind: "none" }` when the job is not cut

401.description: No credential verifier recognized the caller and the actor resolver denies anonymous callers (`unauthenticated`)

403.description: The caller's role, or an API token's scopes, lack the `jobs:write` permission (`forbidden`, `details.permission` names it)

404.description: Unknown job. With site scoping enabled, a job of a site the caller's membership does not grant answers like a missing job (`not_found`)

409.description: The job has no source document or page boxes

422.description: The cut contour edit can not be resolved on the page, or the source is not a readable PDF (`unreadable_pdf`)

cutContours.description: One closed trim rectangle per copy (`copy-<n>`); for a tiled job one panel outline per panel copy (`<panel item id>/copy-<n>`), in `layout.placements` order

imposedPdfBase64.description: One page per roll panel; a tiled job draws each tiling panel as a Form XObject whose /BBox is its clip box on the source page

prefix.description: The first 8 characters of the secret after `bps_`, for display

name.description: Printed in the page title; no control characters, not blank
The Separation colorant name; at most 127 UTF-8 bytes, no control characters, not blank

cmykFallback.description: C, M, Y and K percent of the DeviceCMYK alternate; all zero when absent

options.description: The swatch rows must fit between the margins and below the title

gutter.description: Gap between neighboring cells; at most the smaller sheet side

margin.description: Same on all four sheet edges; must leave a usable area

pageCount.description: Omitted: the plan has no sheets; at most 5000 sheets

items.description: Row 0 is at the top; x and y are the bottom-left of the footprint (y up)

signaturePages.description: "single": every sheet nested in one signature

creep.description: Per sheet, growing inward; the innermost sheet offset must not exceed 10 mm either

options.description: The `POST /imposition/n-up` body for `n-up`, the `POST /imposition/booklet` body for `booklet`

proofMarks.description: Draws the Spec 036c proof marks and labels over the content

whiteInk.description: Optional; absent means white ink is off. A stored value that is not a valid setting reads back absent

oneOf.description: Spec 045c: error diffusion of each plane; it has no tile, so no size or seed

serpentine.description: Optional; absent means every row is scanned left to right

screening.description: Optional; absent means no screening is requested. A stored value that is not a valid setting reads back absent

limitPercent.description: Total area coverage limit in percent

inkLimit.description: Optional; absent means no ink limit is requested. A stored value that is not a valid setting reads back absent

PlaneCurvesSetting.description: At least one channel; `{}` is rejected. A missing channel leaves that plane unchanged

points.description: Inputs strictly increase, the first is 0 and the last 255; outputs never decrease
Inputs strictly increase, the first is 0 and the last 255; outputs never decrease
Inputs strictly increase, the first is 0 and the last 255; outputs never decrease
Inputs strictly increase, the first is 0 and the last 255; outputs never decrease

planeCurves.description: Optional; absent means no curves are requested. A stored value that is not a valid setting reads back absent

TilingSetting.description: `{}` is rejected. Without `seam`, every seam overlaps by the tile default of 25 mm

overlapMm.description: Millimetres each neighbour prints past the seam; absent means the tile default of 25 mm

gapMm.description: Width in millimetres of the unprinted strip centred on the seam

tiling.description: Optional; absent means the job is not tiled. A stored value that is not a valid setting reads back absent

format.description: Spec 043b: how each screened plane is answered. Absent or `packed`: the Spec 043a packed planes with `rowBytes`; `pbm`: each plane is a raw PBM (`P4`) file

c.description: Padded base64 of exactly width * height bytes, so 4 * ceil(width * height / 3) characters

m.description: Padded base64 of exactly width * height bytes, so 4 * ceil(width * height / 3) characters

y.description: Padded base64 of exactly width * height bytes, so 4 * ceil(width * height / 3) characters

k.description: Padded base64 of exactly width * height bytes, so 4 * ceil(width * height / 3) characters

c.description: Base64 of a raw PBM: the header `P4\n<width> <height>\n`, then ceil(width / 8) * height bytes of packed rows

m.description: Base64 of a raw PBM: the header `P4\n<width> <height>\n`, then ceil(width / 8) * height bytes of packed rows

y.description: Base64 of a raw PBM: the header `P4\n<width> <height>\n`, then ceil(width / 8) * height bytes of packed rows

k.description: Base64 of a raw PBM: the header `P4\n<width> <height>\n`, then ceil(width / 8) * height bytes of packed rows

name.description: The sanitized `x-bps-job-name` of an upload, else its server-generated file name

metadata.description: Spec 052a: an upload records `intakeFile` (its server-generated file name) and, when sent, `displayName`

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page
